target: Agreement with SpaceNet 8 Maxar-image interpretations of road segments visibly covered by water or rubble. This is conditional screening on supplied road geometries.

population.selection: All official mapping rows with the single post-image catalogue 10500500E6DD3C00; no second post image

observations.selection: For pre use the single full-envelope Earth Search S2 L2A scene with least scene cloud, then latest time, then ID. Post is the same-day full-envelope scene S2A_32ULB_20210718_1_L2A. Require full scene support for the reference envelope plus the analysis halo.
observations.reflectance: Use explicit Earth Search BOA offset flag and asset calibration, identical to prior drainage experiments
observations.terrain: Copernicus GLO-30, one 30 m projected grid, bilinear resampling, fill and D8. Keep native scale limitations.
observations.independent_outlet: Unavailable; no outlet-constrained arm or claimed gain

unit.type: Native mapped highway LineString or MultiLineString in label file
unit.sampling: Subdivide each part into equal-length bins at most 10 m long and sample at bin midpoints, weighted by represented length. No geometry buffering for direct hits.
unit.eligibility: Finite valid terrain and paired clear optical at >=80% of centreline quadrature support and length >=20 m. Exact geometries deduplicated with conflicts excluded after labels.
unit.reference_label: Explicit flooded yes or no; absent or ambiguous labels remain unknown. Use source label on its supplied geometry, which can include rubble.

comparison.A_post: Post MNDWI>0 fraction of eligible road support
comparison.B_change: Post MNDWI>0 AND pre MNDWI<=0 fraction of eligible road support
comparison.P_proximity: B direct fraction, then negative closest Euclidean distance to a change candidate in the same 30 m seed raster used by D8, capped beyond 300 m
comparison.C_terrain: B direct fraction, then negative shortest D8 path distance from that same seed raster. Stop at 300 m; unknown cells break paths.
comparison.B_ndvi: B change fraction excluding post NDVI>0.2
comparison.B_ndwi: B change fraction requiring post NDWI>0
comparison.prediction_threshold: Direct fraction >=0.2. For P and C also flag proximity or path distance <=90 m.
comparison.review: For B binary error triage compare margin to the 0.2 road threshold against flag-first rankings. NDWI flags if the B decision changes under the NDWI filter; NDVI flags if it changes under the NDVI filter. Ties by stable road ID.
comparison.metrics: Threshold average precision and top-budget retrieval with tie handling; TP FP FN TN, precision recall F1; equal-budget capture of baseline disagreements; class coverage, spatial blocks, and 30 m cardinal lookup perturbation on the same scored roads.
comparison.primary: C vs P for benefit beyond proximity; C vs B and B vs A for secondary interpretation. Added indices are separate ablations. Single event descriptive agreement, no geographic inference or label tuning.
comparison.release: Save geometry-only road inputs and seal prediction rows before parsing flooded values. Public reference data stay local. Preserve missing and ambiguous labels.
